meta.title: Book a Consultation — Astrology, Vastu & Gemstones | Marg Darshan
meta.description: Book your astrology, Vastu or gemstone consultation in 5 easy steps — online on Zoom or in person, times in IST.

page.title: Book your
page.lead: Pick your concern, choose how to meet, share your details and select a convenient time — it takes about 2 minutes.

problem.title: What would you like guidance on?
problem.lead: Choose the area you need help with — we'll match you with the right consultation.

mode.title: Mode & duration
mode.lead: Online or in person — whichever suits you best.
mode.modeLegend: How would you like to meet?
mode.durationHint: Fees depend on the duration; the price stays visible in your summary.

ONLINE_ZOOM.title: Online (Zoom)
ONLINE_ZOOM.desc: Video call from home — the link arrives by email and WhatsApp.

PERSONAL_VISIT.title: Personal visit
PERSONAL_VISIT.desc: Face-to-face at our office, or a Vastu site visit.

details.title: Your details
details.lead: Accurate details mean an accurate reading — everything you share stays confidential.
details.emailHint: Your confirmation and Zoom link will be sent here.
details.profileAttached: Your birth-time rectification details are attached
details.profileAttachedHint: The birth date, place and life events you shared in the Birth Time Finder will be sent with this booking.
details.tobHint: As exact as possible — from the birth certificate or family.
details.windowHint: Roughly between which hours were you born? For example, between 4 and 8 AM.
details.facingHint: The direction you face when stepping out of the main door
details.questionHint: Optional — it helps Acharya Ji prepare in advance.

slot.title: Pick a time
slot.lead: Choose a day and time that suits you. All times are in Indian Standard Time (IST).
slot.error: We couldn't load available times. Please try again.
slot.istNote: Times shown in IST (India Standard Time)

pay.title: Review & pay
pay.lead: Check your details, choose a payment plan and hold your slot for 10 minutes.
